status: static design; no implementation, tests or performance conclusion
profile_context: The supplied 180-second V8 diagnostic timed out on unchanged source. The processed profile includes current-sass-tool-references assertPhysical under side/qualify/predecessor/comparison in table/legacy construction and separate Git-process stacks. Samples are not invocation counts or an owner-duration model. Main source producer passed; the browser guard scratch is unadopted and is not assumed to fix this path.

existing_semantics.side: qualify and predecessorReference each make a deep plain incoming snapshot, metadata(ref), find that exact path and historical identity, return null if row or identity missing, else validate matching DATA hash/optional bytes, execute member(row.after), compare live incoming metadata to snapshot and sweep all current bound physical files before returning the corresponding ref. member performs fresh readEvidenceMember physical, supplied callback equality, fresh physical after, and expected digest/size. Unknown side references return null before member or assertPhysical.
existing_semantics.comparison: comparisonBytes requires known owned identity, returns a fresh Buffer copy of exact historical/derived authenticated comparison DATA, executes current member physical/supplied/physical and own input mutation check, then assertPhysical. It is not an arbitrary historical read or current raw reader.
existing_semantics.owns: ownsReference is a separate pure metadata/identity predicate which returns false on malformed or unknown input and performs no physical sweep. Preserve its distinction; do not fabricate comparison for an unknown reference.
existing_semantics.bound: The instance's actual mutable bound Map is populated by its constructor/read closure; assertPhysical re-reads each current bound path and verifies digest/size. Current source or bytes are never retained as batch state. Original independent public operations keep their current code paths and behavior.

batch_contract.interface: Add a finite synchronous referenceBatch(requests) method owned by the SAME actual currentSassToolReferenceSubject instance. Each immutable request has an exact allowed operation kind qualify, predecessor or comparison and an actual plain reference object; reject unexpected fields, proxy/accessor/cyclic structures and invalid kinds before callbacks. Define a finite explicit maximum and reject empty/oversized if required by the owner. The method offers exactly the existing individual operation capabilities, not arbitrary path reads, source registration, or proof authority.
batch_contract.cold: Before any supplied read callback, snapshot every request/list/reference and nested plain descriptors, exact data and optional bytes. Lock the actual batch operation against same-instance reentry and perform callback-free full physical bound sweep and loaded planner/identity validation. The cold sweep is intentionally stronger than independent side(null) calls; document it and only opt in proven constructor paths.
batch_contract.per_request: Execute existing operation's pure identity lookup and original null/throw rules. For each owned success perform the real member(row.after): fresh physical/supplied/physical, hash and size; do not collapse requests even when refs/paths coincide. Validate exact selected authenticated DATA before/after digest/size. Preserve every logical predecessor-to-current mapping, optional bytes field, and original explicit comparison behavior. Capture outputs as local isolated DATA/metadata snapshots while batch is in progress; no current source bytes or arbitrary reads stored.
batch_contract.metadata: Validate each input immediately after its own callback as original, then revalidate the request list/each reference and immutable output snapshots after ALL callbacks before returning. A later callback mutating an earlier request must not redirect already-captured judgment. Revalidate before each use too. Reject mutated descriptors, accessors, proxy, lengths or data; preserve tolerated ordinary extra reference metadata and the original plain()/metadata() semantics. Be explicit that snapshot timing/callback order differs from original under adversarial changing request objects.
batch_contract.final: Perform a callback-free fresh full physical sweep over the LIVE actual bound Map after all callbacks and final metadata validation. Do not snapshot the bound path set early if legitimate member calls can enlarge it. Recheck planner/loaded identity and input snapshot after sweep as required. Clear batch lock in finally on any throw. Return all outputs together only after success, with no stored result or validity flag; next batch starts over. An invalid comparison request follows existing error semantics; unknown qualify/predecessor stays null (still subject to explicitly documented extra batch pre/final checks).
batch_contract.limitations: No public independent operation's cold/full sweep may be deleted or silently redirected through state from a preceding batch. A batch may change callback order and provide one post-batch sweep rather than each public operation's immediate sweep; preserve actual data comparisons/final union and document that continuous immutability between observations is not promised. It is not authority to skip later supplied reads or later owner guards.

table_candidate.bootstrap: Keep member(INPUTS) to authenticate and parse the packet, member(SELF), original Git-data acquisition and literal-edit proof. Packet does not exist until after its real checked read; do not invent a speculative packet or cache its parsed content across factory calls.
table_candidate.finite_selection: After genuine packet parse, collect an ordered immutable request list for exact static refs from packet.code_transitions[*].after and packet.source_members, and other explicitly static packet image refs only after checking real ownership and which operations each original member would call. These are requests to THIS repairs instance, not to table frame or another independently constructed repairs owner. For each item, preserve own ownsReference decision, qualify output or null and comparison only where owned; no comparison on unknown. Each literal edit/historical Git before proof remains in original per-row logic, and every member still performs its own fresh supplied raw read, its expected logical hash/size, its qualified physical hash, and readEvidenceMember physical equality.
table_candidate.do_not_flatten: frames.ownsReference/predecessorData/registrySubject and registry/ledger/roster frame pairs are dynamic operations with distinct authenticated predecessor and physical judgments. They are not repairs batch operations and must remain original. Do not batch them by same path or replace their frame guards. No assumption packet.source_members never overlaps transitions; ordered multiplicity must be retained.
table_candidate.ordering_risk: Original member reads supplied raw BEFORE repairs.qualify/comparison each time. Batch-before-members moves qualifier callbacks before those raw reads, so static request proof + fresh per-member physical/supplied/physical checks and enclosing final are required; user-specified internal callback counts/order are not stable but valid historical projection and consumed bytes are. If a constructor consumer uses an earlier qualified result as current authority after later callbacks, add its own immediate actual read comparison and ensure final physical scope, not a cached success.

legacy_candidate.constraint: Legacy constructs one real successor table subject. Its member uses successor.ownsReference, successor.qualifyReference and successor.comparisonBytes, not the inner repairs instance directly. Adding a current-tool batch alone does not let legacy safely bypass that successor's composition.
legacy_candidate.viable_narrow_path: After legacy packet has been read/authenticated and its static code_transition after-refs and source_members known, add a separately reviewed DATA-only batch facade on THAT actual successor table subject. Its preparation must faithfully resolve table transitions, frames, repairs and registry in original branches, then delegate only requests known to belong to the SAME actual repairs instance to that instance's batch. Each legacy member still reads actual supplied raw and physical fresh and verifies its own captured logical comparison and qualified ref. If exact forwarding cannot preserve every table/frame action, leave those operations individual; do not access or expose a hidden arbitrary current-tool reader.
legacy_candidate.dynamic_exclusion: registrySubject, qualifyRegistry, frames.registrySubject, predecessorData and paths that determine current registry/ledger frame perform separate current/supplied/physical operations and may bind dynamic refs. Keep them individual with their original guards. Do not precompute their verdict or share between distinct successor/table/repair objects. Independent constructors remain independent even for identical commit/path.

must_prove_before_use: No blanket cross-instance or cross-call identity/value/byte caches, including storing an earlier qualification as a verdict. Returned expected refs and immutable authenticated Git DATA can be held locally as input to later fresh checks, not as proof current state still holds.

All data sources needed to enumerate refs are already genuinely authenticated before batching; preserve optional byte counts, extra reference fields and the difference between unknown null and rejected comparison. Snapshot request containers safely without granting caller authority over prior or after data.

Guard batch activity against direct/alternate plan reentry on that actual current-tool instance; original side operations may be called during supplied callbacks and must not silently bypass active lock. If original independently nested operations are legitimate, separate well-defined per-node locks and test; do not impose a blanket reentry rule without verifying real route.

There is no exposed last-write or transaction-result cache. Full owner/constructor must preserve real Git DATA checks, source literal transformations, per-member raw bytes, physical before/after and final across every callback, including late lower-only mutation.

Review fallback and timing for initial cold sweep: existing independent side operations sweep only after successful match. An unknown-only batch acquiring extra physical checks can reject a scenario previously accepted; confine to intended internal constructor cases or retain original path where preserving this distinction matters.
tests: Compare batch vs original individual methods on actual finite static refs for both branches: known before/current/after, unknown null, missing/invalid size, malformed plain refs, exact errors for comparison, preserved extra data and byte copies; no fake registration.

Count each per-request actual member supplied callback and physical before/after, including repeated same path; ensure next batch and independent public ops reread. Show no callback on initial cold corrupted bound restored by first callback, and reject later callback corrupting earlier/lower-only physical member at final.

Mutation of request descriptor, nested metadata or earlier request during a later callback rejects before returning any results; wrong supplied bytes and physical mutation during member callback reject. Same-instance reentrant batch, direct independent op and alternate guard graph are exercised with finally recovery.

Genuine table/legacy packet construction checks transition order, original literal edits, all real per-member inputs, exact 70->69->68 and registry predecessor paths. Contrast actual batching with unknown/frame/registry excluded route and independent object identity. Full source producers and independent profile review precede any fresh owner/timing claim.
execution: Static inspection only; no source edits, tests, producers or owner runs.
